name: Orniary
description: The artifice school and yard in Kroog where cadets train with avengers.

description_citations.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kroog is attacked at dawn, and Sanwell and four other cadets stand in the orniary yard facing refurbished avengers, with Sanwell sick with nerves.
timeline.quote: Kroog died on a crimson morning.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Llora calls the five cadets up to crew avengers and asks whether Sanwell is ready to fight for Kroog.
timeline.quote: Training is over. Today's the day you save Kroog.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Sanwell is given a command rod and paired with the new prototype avenger, Sword One, and puts it through its commands.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos promotes the five cadets to full pilots and briefs them on the Mardun crossing and Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: The first waves of Mishra's force have crossed the Mardun; they control the River Wards.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos orders the avengers to take down the dragon engines and tells the pilots to run if in danger, heading to Hench.
timeline.quote: We need you and your avengers to take down the dragon engines,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.
